scope: Every new rate has its own native ngspice trace. Existing 3.2/16/32 anchors reused with hashes. No rescaled circuit waveform, no blue emitter model or measured link claim.

conditions.selection: Maximize min(training signed amplitude/7.5uAeq, training time/(0.37 line-bit UI)); earliest exact tie; freeze on disjoint validation.
conditions.limitations: TT schematic nominal screen. Fixed deterministic frame, no random noise/CDR/FEC/BER qualification; max passing tested point only.

envelopes.interpretation: Discrete tested nominal envelope only; no interpolation, monotonicity proof, PVT, BER or physical device maximum.
